folders.title: Watched Folders
folders.modeDesc: Choose how Mouzi handles files in this folder.

archive.title: Import archive
archive.description: Pick a Google Takeout .zip, .tgz, or .tar.gz archive. Mouzi extracts it, flattens duplicate nested names safely, and runs your rules.

general.title: General
general.gracePeriodDesc: Wait time before moving a file after it was last modified. 0 = instant.
general.checkFileLockDesc: Skip files currently in use by another process

ignore.title: Ignore
ignore.description: Choose a watched folder and set patterns for files Mouzi should skip. Patterns are saved as a .mouziignore file in that folder.
ignore.noRules: No ignore rules yet. Add one below.

about.title: About
about.description: Mouzi is a silent, elegant file organizer that lives in your system tray and keeps your Downloads folder (and any other folder) automatically tidy. It runs quietly in the background, monitors selected folders, and moves, renames, or sorts files based on customizable rules.
about.supportDesc: Your support keeps Mouzi improving. Thank you! 🙏

scheduler.title: Scheduler
scheduler.desc: Run Clean Now automatically at scheduled times.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.noData: Nothing indexed yet — run a scan
dashboard.leadEmpty: Run a scan to see where your files live
dashboard.scanNoRoots: Add a watched folder in Settings first

cleanup.title: Smart Cleanup
cleanup.dashboardHint: Find duplicates, large files, stale files, and empty folders
cleanup.noScanData: No scan data — run a scan first
cleanup.largeHint: Show files larger than this threshold.
cleanup.staleHint: Show files not modified in more than N days.
cleanup.emptyDirsHint: Folders containing no files at any depth. Only deepest empty folders are listed.
cleanup.duplicatesHint: Files with identical content. Keep one copy per group.
cleanup.historyEmptyDirs: Empty folder removals are not undoable.

suggestions.title: Suggestions
suggestions.hint: AI-assisted organization for unclassified files. Run a scan first from the Dashboard.
suggestions.createRule: Create a rule from this acceptance

confirm.bytesUnknown: The exact total is not known until the run starts.
confirm.trashNotice: Removed files go to the Recycle Bin, so you can put them back - but only while the Recycle Bin can accept the item. If the bin is full, the item is too large, or the folder is on a network drive, Windows deletes it permanently instead, and Mouzi is not told.
confirm.moveNotice: Files are moved, not deleted, so nothing leaves your disks. You can reverse this from History - until the history is cleared.
confirm.permanentNotice: This cannot be undone. There is no Recycle Bin copy and no way to recover it.

note.cleanNow: Every file in the watched folders that matches your rules is moved right now, without waiting for the grace period.
note.removeFolder: Mouzi stops watching this folder. Files already moved stay where they are.
note.deleteRule: Future files will no longer be sorted by this rule.
note.undoAll: Entries that are already undone are skipped.
note.acceptAllRules: {{count}} new rule will be created and switched on
note.acceptAllRules_one: {{count}} new rule will be created and switched on
note.acceptAllRules_other: {{count}} new rules will be created and switched on
note.clearHistory: {{count}} history entry will be erased, and every Undo goes with it
note.clearHistory_one: {{count}} history entry will be erased, and every Undo goes with it
note.clearHistory_other: {{count}} history entries will be erased, and every Undo goes with it

undo.missing: File not found - it was not restored
undo.noId: This history entry has no id, so it cannot be undone
undo.allCollision: {{count}} file(s) restored under a different name
undo.allCollision_one: {{count}} file restored under a different name
undo.allCollision_other: {{count}} files restored under a different name
undo.allMissing: {{count}} file(s) could not be found and were not restored
undo.allMissing_one: {{count}} file could not be found and was not restored
undo.allMissing_other: {{count}} files could not be found and were not restored
